raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The multi-layer EAGLE boundary-KV fix (`SGLANG_ENABLE_MTP_BOUNDARY_KV_FIX`, on by default, added in #31681) widens each draft-extend window by K - 1 front rows, plus the conv warm-up rows on hybrid models, and re-runs them so the draft KV at already-landed positions is rebuilt from confirmed tokens.

`MultiLayerEagleDraftWorker._init_boundary_kv_fix_state` only turns it on when the request pool holds state slots, i.e. on hybrid (mamba / sconv) models. The conv warm-up rows are already gated on the pool on their own (`draft_extend_num_warmup_tokens`). The K - 1 rows come from the chain depth, not from the cache. So a chain draft (`chain_mtp_hidden_states`) on a plain cache never gets the fix, and its startup log never prints `SGLANG_ENABLE_MTP_BOUNDARY_KV_FIX on: draft-extend windows widened by ...`. Of the current chain drafts, `Step3p5MTP` runs on a plain cache.

Why the rows matter: in chain MTP, step k at position q embeds the token at q + k + 1. A draft-extend window only covers the K + 1 new positions, so near its end that token is still a draft guess. The next window starts past those positions and never rewrites them. Each round, step k keeps min(k + 1, accept_len) landed positions whose draft KV was built from a token that was later rejected, and the count grows with k.

## Modifications

- Gate the fix on `chain_mtp_hidden_states or req_to_token_pool.holds_state_slots`. Hybrid models are unchanged, and the conv warm-up rows stay hybrid-only.
- Non-chain drafts on a plain cache (MiMoV2) still skip the fix, as #31681 set up. The guessed-token argument looks like it applies to them as well, since they also rotate the draft guesses into `input_ids`, but I left that out of this PR.
- `test/registered/unit/spec/test_multi_layer_eagle_boundary_kv_gate.py` (CPU, `base-a-test-cpu`): front-row count and stash shapes for chain / non-chain drafts on hybrid / plain caches, and the env switch. The chain-on-plain-cache case fails on main and passes here.

The widened window needs an attention backend that reads the per-request draft-extend width. FlashAttention, which `Step3p5` selects by default on Hopper and Blackwell, takes the draft-extend-v2 width from the request's extend lengths in the eager, capture and replay paths. The DSA backend does not: its draft-extend-v2 path repeats the page table by `speculative_num_draft_tokens`. No current chain draft runs on DSA, but one that does will need that fixed too.

## Accuracy Tests

Not measured on its own. An internal fork serving a 7-step chain MTP draft on a plain (non-hybrid) MLA cache runs with this change; with it, the startup log shows the widened window. That fork also needed a second fix for chain MTP under DP attention, #48188; the acceptance numbers there were measured with both changes.

Local checks, CPU only: the new unit test, and `test_kv_cache_configurator_draft_gate.py`, `test_weight_update_runners.py`, `test_draft_per_runner_config.py`, `test_eagle_draft_extend_cuda_graph_runner.py`, `test_mlp_sync_pad_unpad.py` give the same results before and after the change. Not run end to end on Step-3.5.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

For chain drafts on a plain cache, each decode draft-extend now runs K - 1 more rows per request, the same cost hybrid models already pay. Nothing else changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -248,9 +248,13 @@ def _init_boundary_kv_fix_state(self):
             boundary_kv_fix_enabled()
             and self.topk == 1
             and self.speculative_num_steps > 1
-            # The fix stashes the mamba/sconv boundary state, so it only applies
-            # to hybrid models; non-hybrid MTP drafts (e.g. MiMoV2) must skip it.
-            and self.req_to_token_pool.holds_state_slots
+            # The K - 1 front rows rebuild draft KV that a step wrote from a
+            # token still a draft guess at the time; hybrid models add the conv
+            # warm-up rows below. Chain drafts need the rows on any cache.
+            # Non-chain drafts on a plain cache (e.g. MiMoV2) still skip it.
+            and (
+                self.chain_mtp_hidden_states or self.req_to_token_pool.holds_state_slots
+            )
         ):
             return
         draft_model_runner = self.draft_runner_list[0]

@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+"""Which multi-layer EAGLE drafts widen the draft-extend window.
+
+The boundary-KV fix re-runs front rows below the committed length so the draft
+KV there is recomputed from confirmed tokens. A chain draft's step k at
+position q embeds the token at q + k + 1, still a draft guess when q was
+written, so every chain draft needs the K - 1 rows; a hybrid (state-slot) cache
+adds the conv warm-up rows on top. Only a non-chain draft on a plain cache
+skips the fix.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.speculative.multi_layer_eagle_worker_v2 import (
+    MultiLayerEagleDraftWorker,
+)
+
+NUM_STEPS = 4
+CONV_WARMUP = 3
+HIDDEN = 8
+REQ_POOL = 5
+
+
+def _draft_worker(*, chain: bool, hybrid: bool) -> MultiLayerEagleDraftWorker:
+    # skip __init__: only the attributes _init_boundary_kv_fix_state reads are set
+    worker = object.__new__(MultiLayerEagleDraftWorker)
+    worker.topk = 1
+    worker.speculative_num_steps = NUM_STEPS
+    worker.chain_mtp_hidden_states = chain
+    worker.device = "cpu"
+    worker.req_to_token_pool = SimpleNamespace(
+        holds_state_slots=hybrid,
+        req_to_token=torch.zeros((REQ_POOL, 32), dtype=torch.int32),
+    )
+    worker.draft_runner_list = [
+        SimpleNamespace(
+            model_config=SimpleNamespace(hidden_size=HIDDEN), dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+    ]
+    # min(conv[0].shape[2:]) is the conv warm-up width.
+    conv = [torch.zeros(2, 6, CONV_WARMUP)]
+    state_part = SimpleNamespace(mamba_cache=SimpleNamespace(conv=conv))
+    worker.target_worker = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_runner=SimpleNamespace(
+            model_config=SimpleNamespace(hidden_size=HIDDEN),
+            token_to_kv_pool=SimpleNamespace(
+                layer_router=SimpleNamespace(part_view=lambda part: state_part)
+            ),
+        )
+    )
+    return worker
+
+
+class TestBoundaryKvFixGate(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_front_rows_by_draft_kind_and_cache(self):
+        chain_depth = NUM_STEPS - 1
+        cases = (
+            # (chain, hybrid, front rows)
+            (True, False, chain_depth),
+            (True, True, chain_depth + CONV_WARMUP),
+            (False, True, chain_depth + CONV_WARMUP),
+            (False, False, 0),
+        )
+        for chain, hybrid, front in cases:
+            with self.subTest(chain=chain, hybrid=hybrid):
+                worker = _draft_worker(chain=chain, hybrid=hybrid)
+                with envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_MTP_BOUNDARY_KV_FIX.override(True):
+                    worker._init_boundary_kv_fix_state()
+                self.assertEqual(worker.draft_extend_num_front_tokens, front)
+                if front == 0:
+                    self.assertIsNone(worker.boundary_kv_stash_tokens)
+                    continue
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    worker.draft_extend_num_warmup_tokens,
+                    CONV_WARMUP if hybrid else 0,
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    tuple(worker.boundary_kv_stash_tokens.shape), (REQ_POOL, front)
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    tuple(worker.boundary_kv_stash_hiddens.shape),
+                    (REQ_POOL, front, HIDDEN),
+                )
+
+    def test_disabled_by_env(self):
+        worker = _draft_worker(chain=True, hybrid=False)
+        with envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_MTP_BOUNDARY_KV_FIX.override(False):
+            worker._init_boundary_kv_fix_state()
+        self.assertEqual(worker.draft_extend_num_front_tokens, 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
